messages:
santiago_customer: Hey team — we're getting inconsistent behavior from the /rerank endpoint after copying the example from the Console. From the browser Console it sometimes returns 400 'candidates must be an array', and when it does succeed the scores are tiny floats like 1e-45.

elaine_support: Can you paste the exact POST you ran from shell vs what you pasted in the Console? Also which model/version?

santiago_customer: We're on text-rerank-001, tiny payload (5 candidates). In Console we pasted the snippet shown in the playground. The exact curl we ran from our CI (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "query": "best onboarding flow for new users",
    "candidates": {
      "title": "Welcome flow",
      "body": "greet users with steps"
    }
  }'
```

santiago_customer: That exact payload was accepted in the Console UI but failed from our shell with 400. When we fixed candidates to be an array it returned results but the scores look wrong.

luis_engineering: Two likely issues: 1) Console docs showing candidates as an object -> 400 in strict clients. 2) If numeric fields like weights or relevance are sent as strings, the backend may coerce and underflow resulting in near-zero scores.

elaine_support: @jane_docs can you check the Console quickstart snippet? We should patch if it's wrong.

jane_docs: Confirmed — the playground example got accidentally changed to an object during a markdown refactor. The REST examples were correct. I'll open a PR to update the Console snippet and add a 'common mistakes' note.

luis_engineering: For the score anomalies please check your proxy/server logs for the final JSON body posted to our API. Common templating bug: arrays or numbers rendered into strings. Example we see often: 

```json
{"query":"best onboarding flow for new users","candidates":[{"title":"Welcome flow","body":"greet users"}],"weights":"[1,1,1]"}
```

santiago_customer: Yep, that's exactly what our proxy showed. weights came out as a string because we assembled parameters with a templating library that stringifies lists.

luis_engineering: That will cause the reranker to attempt parsing and sometimes mis-handle types, producing underflowed scores. Quick fix: ensure numeric arrays are real arrays, not quoted strings.

elaine_support: Short-term guidance we're adding to KB: prefer posting payload files to curl to avoid shell quoting mistakes. Example payload.json: 

```json
{
  "query": "best onboarding flow for new users",
  "candidates": [
    {"title": "Welcome flow", "body": "should greet users with a checklist"},
    {"title": "Slack-first flow", "body": "onboard via messages"}
  ],
  "weights": [1, 1, 1]
}
```

And then post with: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @payload.json
```

elaine_support: We're also going to add a snippet showing how copying from browser devtools can introduce smart quotes or escaped newlines and how to avoid that.

jane_docs: PR opened to replace the Console playground example and add a section 'Avoid quoting pitfalls' and 'When templating, verify types' — link: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/992. Adding payload.json example and a note about using @payload.json with curl.

luis_engineering: I'll create a low-risk server-side guard: detect top-level fields that should be numeric arrays (weights, boosts, priors). If they're strings and parseable as JSON arrays, attempt to coerce but log a warning. If not parseable return a clearer 400: "numeric array fields must be arrays of numbers — did you send a stringified array?" Filed INF-4312.

incident_bot: Incident created: DOCS-992 (priority: low) — Console snippet mismatch; Ticket INF-4312 created.

santiago_customer: Thanks — after sending a proper payload.json everything looks normal. One more Q: any tips to avoid shell quoting issues when copying examples from the in-browser Console?

elaine_support: Short tips to add into docs and the KB: 1) Prefer -d @payload.json to avoid quoting headaches. 2) Use double quotes consistently in JSON. 3) If you must inline JSON, wrap the whole payload in single quotes and use escaped double quotes inside, or use a here-document (cat <<'EOF' | curl -d @- ...). 4) Watch templating engines that auto-stringify lists.

jane_docs: Added the tips to the PR and included a small troubleshooting checklist: check candidates are an array, ensure numeric arrays are not quoted, validate content-type header, and capture the exact request body from your proxy for debugging.

luis_engineering: Also proposing a tiny helper header (X-Rerank-Debug: types) that echoes back the parsed root types for quick client-side validation — we can discuss with product.

elaine_support: Closing notes: docs PR merged, INF-4312 opened for server validation/guard, and internal KB page created: "Rerank input formatting — arrays, numbers, quoting". Reopen the thread if it happens again. :thumbsup:
